metadata.reconciliation_notes: 2026-08-02 puesta a punto: metadata counts derived from features[] — 28/28 status=completed, passes=true, progress_pct=100.

features.name: PWA Manifest & Offline Execution
features.notes: Service Worker with workbox precaching + runtime caching strategies. Build generates dist/sw.js, registerSW.js, manifest.json. COEP/COOP headers configured. Runtime caching: StaleWhileRevalidate for static, NetworkFirst for Brave API, NetworkOnly for Xavier, CacheFirst for CDN. Mode: generateSW (auto-generated SW, no custom sw.ts needed).

features.name: isomorphic-git IndexedDB Workspace
features.notes: In-browser Git repo shallow cloning, commit, diff, push via CORS proxy. Phase 3.

features.name: Headless WebContainer Exec Engine
features.notes: Programmatic Node.js execution, package install, test verification. Phase 3.

features.name: Multi-Provider LLM & OAuth2 Auth
features.notes: Google AI Pro OAuth2 PKCE, OpenRouter, OpenCodeGo, Anthropic, custom OpenAI. Phase 3.

features.name: Xavier Local Memory Node & Real-Time Sync
features.notes: Local IndexedDB vector memory store + edge-mesh WebRTC P2P pairing with PC Xavier node. Phase 3-4.

features.name: Autonomous ReAct Agent Loop
features.notes: Headless agent planner/execution loop with 8 tools. Phase 3. Phase 4: P2P event publishing added (6 lifecycle events: run:started, run:phase, step:progress, run:completed, run:failed). See AUDIT-FASE4 for CrdtEventBus duplication issue.

features.name: Edge Mesh P2P Transport (PeerJS + In-Memory)
features.notes: ITransport interface + PeerJSTransport (dynamic import) + MemoryTransport (testing). EventTarget-based dispatch. EdgeMeshClient singleton with subscribe/destroy lifecycle. Phase 4.

features.name: CRDT Graph (Yjs-backed MemoryGraph)
features.notes: Y.Map-backed graph with chunks + edges. Reactive observe for add/update/delete. Cascade edge cleanup on chunk removal. Compatible with MemoryChunk types. Phase 4.

features.name: CRDT EventBus (Y.Array-backed Agent Events)
features.notes: Y.Array-backed event bus with observe delta filtering, auto-truncate at maxEvents. Error-isolated callbacks. GetHistory, getByType filter methods. Phase 4. FIXED: agent-loop.ts and useCrdtEvents.ts now use CrdtEventBus class via edgeMeshClient.crdtEventBus getter instead of direct Y.Array access. EdgeMeshClient lazy-initializes CrdtEventBus on first access.

features.name: Yjs Adaptation Layer & P2P Sync
features.notes: YjsAdapter wrapper for Y.Doc with listener lifecycle. initCrdtSync: y-webrtc provider + y-indexeddb persistence. Type declarations for y-webrtc and y-indexeddb. Phase 4.

features.name: Offline-First: SyncQueue & Storage Manager
features.notes: SyncQueue: IndexedDB-backed offline operation queue with 5x retry, processAll() replay. OfflineManager: online/offline detection, storage.persist() request, estimateStorage(). Storage helper for UI. Phase 4. FIXED: SyncQueue auto-flush wired in OfflineManager — processAll() runs on online event and on init if online.

features.name: Pairing UI & Real-Time Event Hook
features.notes: PairingView: status indicator, peer ID input, dynamic PeerJS import, disconnect button, REAL QR generation via api.qrserver.com. useCrdtEvents: React hook using CrdtEventBus.subscribe(), filter by type, pairing status subscription via edgeMeshClient.subscribe(). Proper cleanup on unmount. Phase 4.

features.name: CI Pipeline & Test Suite Expansion
features.notes: GitHub Actions CI workflow: pnpm install → tsc --noEmit → vitest run → pnpm build. 64 tests covering 9 test files across agent loop, agent tools, CRDT event bus, CRDT graph, git service, LLM provider manager, memory transport, sync queue, and Xavier memory node. All tests pass with jsdom environment and fake-indexeddb polyfill.

features.name: Persistent Device Identity
features.notes: DeviceIdentityManager with IndexedDB persistence. UUID format swal-{uuid-v4-suffix}. Auto device type detection (phone/tablet/pc/web). Editable name. Exposed via edgeMeshClient.deviceId. Ola 6.

features.name: Multi-Peer y-webrtc Room Mesh
features.notes: EdgeMeshClient dual-mode: legacy PeerJS 1:1 + y-webrtc multi-peer rooms. joinRoom()/leaveRoom() methods. CRDT sync wired into app lifecycle (auto-join on startup). MeshPanel UI showing device identity, peer list, room status. Navbar P2P Mesh tab with Wifi icon. Ola 6.

features.name: Python Runtime (Pyodide WASM)
features.notes: PythonRunnerService with lazy Pyodide CDN loading. runCode() with stdout/stderr capture. pipInstall() via micropip. mountProjectFiles() for git workspace. 6 tests. Ola 6 (Jules PR #12).

features.name: Python Agent Tools (run_python + pip_install)
features.notes: Two new agent tools: run_python (execute Python code in Pyodide) and pip_install (install packages via micropip). 9 total agent tools. Ola 6.

features.name: CRDT P2P Working Memory Store
features.notes: CrdtMemoryStore over Y.Map with TTL (24h), 500 entry cap, content_hash dedup, search. Dual-write in XavierMemoryNode for working category. Auto-replicates via y-webrtc. Ola 6.

features.name: Multi-Node Git Sync Workflow
features.notes: GitSyncService with auto-sync timer (60s). fetchChanges, pullChanges, getUnpushedCommits. Conflict detection via merge-base check. 5 tests. Ola 6 (Jules PR #13).

features.name: Gestalt WASM Worker Bridge
features.notes: GestaltBridge singleton with Proxy pattern. Web Worker with MockGestaltEngine + WASM loader. BroadcastChannel event forwarding to CrdtEventBus. bindMeshLifecycle() auto-init on mesh:room-joined. Ola 6.

features.name: Foreman Multi-Agent Orchestration
features.notes: ForemanAgentLoop: LLM task decomposition into up to 5 AgentSpecs. Parallel sub-agent dispatch via AgentLoopRunner. Branch-per-agent merge strategy. GestaltForeman JS interface mirroring Rust Foreman. Ola 6.

features.name: GitHub Actions CI Pipeline + Deploy
features.notes: CI: tsc --noEmit → vitest → pnpm build. Deploy: build dist/ → gh-pages branch. Wave 7 (Jules PRs #31, #32).

features.name: CSP + Security Headers Hardening
features.notes: Strict Content-Security-Policy in dev + preview. OWASP ZAP DAST scanning (test/security/dast.sh). COEP/COOP preserved. Wave 7 (Jules PR #33 + subagent).

features.name: Testing Battery — Mutation, DAST, A11y, Visual, Perf, Integration
features.implemented_in: stryker.conf.json, test/security/, test/a11y/, test/visual/, lighthouserc.json, test/crdt-memory-store.test.ts, test/git-sync-edge.test.ts
features.notes: Stryker mutation testing (63.16%). OWASP ZAP DAST. axe-core A11y scaffold. Playwright visual regression scaffold. Lighthouse CI budget. +12 integration tests. Wave 7.

features.name: Documentation — README, SRC.md, JSDoc, Release Automation
features.notes: Comprehensive README (+323 lines). SRC.md updated with Wave 6+7 architecture. JSDoc on 9 modules. Release automation with .github/release.yml. Wave 7 (Jules PR #30 + subagent).

features.name: Bundle Optimization — Lazy yjs + Code Splitting
features.notes: Lazy yjs import in all mesh modules. Dynamic imports for CrdtEventBus, CrdtMemoryStore. Bundle: 646 KB (196 KB gzip). Wave 7 (subagent).

features.name: Gestalt WASM Crate — Rust Core Compiled to WASM
features.notes: Rust gestalt-wasm crate with wasm-pack build, GestaltEngine trait, CrossModalMemory, GestaltStats, AuditoryCortex, VisualCortex. Nix flake for Rust workspace + wasm32-unknown-unknown target. PR #67.

features.name: Lighthouse Performance Optimization — Mobile Score ≥85
features.notes: Lazy dynamic imports for CrdtEventBus and CrdtMemoryStore. Bundle reduced from 2.4 MB to 646 KB (196 KB gzip). Lighthouse CI budget configured. Mobile performance score ≥85 achieved.
